name: Majo no Shokeibi ~Saiai Naru Yoake e~ Kouhen
original_name: 魔女の処刑日 ～最愛なる夜明けへ～ 後編
source:
In the previous story, the protagonist, Yaneko, transformed into a witch to seek revenge…
But at the same time, a man was setting his own plans into motion behind the scenes.
His goal was simple—to save the girl, Yaneko.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/girls/work/=/product_id/RJ172105.html]dlsite[/url]]
